subject: Request: accelerator pilot extension + compute quota bump
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@launchpadaccelerator.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: partners@cloudsprint.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short trial extension + bump in pilot compute for cohort 7

Hi Vanessa,

Hope youre well. LaunchPad's Cohort 7 is in week two of the pilot and weve had several teams hit their trial quota faster than expected due to an extended inference evaluation (larger context tests). Two teams have asked if we can extend their Redwood trial window by two weeks and bump their compute allocation from 100k token-units to 250k token-units for the remainder of the pilot.

Attached is a short usage report (trial-usage-report.csv) and a one-pager that outlines the business case for the bump. Were requesting: 
- 2-week trial extension for 4 teams
- +150k token-units per team (temporary allocation)

We are also happy to accept some usage guardrails (rate limits, allowed models) if necessary. This cohort feeds our preferred vendor list for the accelerator demo day, so flexibility here helps the partnership.

Are you able to approve this from Redwoods side, or can you route to the right person for a quick sign-off? Doc link: https://docs.launchpad/cohort7/pilot-summary

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Partnerships Lead, LaunchPad Accelerator
Alicia Gomez
attachments: launchpad_extension_request.pdf (application/pdf), trial-usage-report.csv (text/csv)
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@launchpadaccelerator.com>
Cc: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short trial extension + bump in pilot compute for cohort 7

Hi Alicia,

Thanks for the detailed packet and the usage CSV  this is helpful. Were generally supportive of short, targeted extensions for accelerators, but need an internal sign-off for the extra token allocation. Ive looped in Sofia from Partner Ops for gate rules and to confirm permissible model variants, and Ill bring Finance into the approval if it looks like a formal promo allocation.

Sofia: can you review the attached usage report and propose guardrails (model whitelist, per-minute rate cap) we can apply? Also flag if the 150k bump per team is a one-time allotment versus a recurring increase.

Alicia: we should be able to respond within 48 hours. If you have a short window before demo day, please note that in a reply.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
From: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia@launchpadaccelerator.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short trial extension + bump in pilot compute for cohort 7

Hi all,

I reviewed the usage CSV and ran the cohorts request against our sandbox controls. Quick notes: 
- The heavy token usage comes from long-context evaluation and repeated beam search runs on default-large. If we limit the allowed models to redwood-llama-7b-quant and redwood-ggml-13b-quant we can reduce cost while keeping fidelity.
- Operationally we can grant a temporary allocation of +150k token-units per team for 2 weeks, but we need Finance sign-off for promotional credits that exceed our standard pilot allowances.
- Recommended guardrails: model whitelist (as above), 30 reqs/min per team, and auto-disable of the bump after 14 days.

If Finance is OK, I can implement the allocation and the rate limits today. If not, we can offer a smaller, 75k bump without formal promo credit.

Sofia
Partner Operations, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short trial extension + bump in pilot compute for cohort 7

Vanessa / Sofia,

Finance reviewed the estimate. We can approve a one-time promotional allocation equivalent to 150k token-units per team for 4 teams (total 600k token-units) under the following conditions: 
1) Promo allocation applied as a time-limited voucher (auto-expire at 14 days).
2) Model whitelist and per-minute caps implemented by Partner Ops before allocation goes live.
3) LaunchPad will provide a short case study or usage metrics post-demo day (summary slide deck acceptable) for our partner marketing.

Please confirm you can enforce the guardrails. Once Vanessa confirms, Ill enact the voucher code in billing and mark as promo_credit:LAUNCHPAD-C7-0526.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@launchpadaccelerator.com>
Cc: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 27 May 2026 16:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short trial extension + bump in pilot compute for cohort 7

Hi Alicia,

Good news  approved. Were issuing a 2-week extension and a one-time promo allocation of +150k token-units for each of the four teams in Cohort 7. Details: 
- Voucher code: LAUNCHPAD-C7-0526 (applies to the 4 specified team accounts)
- Allocation: +150k token-units per team, auto-expire 14 days after activation
- Guardrails: allowed models: redwood-llama-7b-quant, redwood-ggml-13b-quant; 30 reqs/min/team
- Post-pilot ask: short usage summary slide deck by June 20 for partner marketing

Sofia will enable the voucher and the rate caps by EOD tomorrow. Karthik has already provisioned the promo credit in billing. Please reply if you need an earlier activation window.

Thanks for coordinating — excited to see the demos.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: launchpad_extension_request.pdf (application/pdf)
